proof_body:
by
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun n => ?_⟩
  · refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_nat_ge x
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop N] with n hn
    have hx : x ≤ (n : ℝ) := hN.trans (by exact_mod_cast hn)
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem]
    intro hmem
    exact absurd hmem.1 (not_lt.2 hx)
  · rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc, MeasureTheory.setLIntegral_const, Real.volume_Ioc]
    simp
target_source: (∀ x : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (Set.Ioc (n : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) + 1)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, ∫⁻ x, (Set.Ioc (n : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) + 1)).indicator (fun _ => (1 : ENNReal)) x ∂MeasureTheory.volume = 1)
